AlexstraszaLiveAndLetLiveGiftOfLife.name: Live and Let Live
AlexstraszaLiveAndLetLiveGiftOfLife.description: While above 75% Health, Gift of Life's cooldown recharges 125% faster. Dragonqueen: While above 75% Health, Breath of Life's cooldown recharges 25% faster.

AlexstraszaCircleOfLifeAbundance.name: Circle of Life
AlexstraszaCircleOfLifeAbundance.description: Quest: Collect Regeneration Globes. Reward: After collecting 10 Regeneration Globes, Abundance heals for an additional 5% maximum Health. Reward: After collecting 15 Regeneration Globes, Abundance's healing burst creates a Regeneration Globe.

AlexstraszaFlamesOfFuryFlameBuffet.name: Flames of Fury
AlexstraszaFlamesOfFuryFlameBuffet.description: Reduce the Mana cost of Flame Buffet from 50 to 40. Quest: Hit Burning enemy Heroes with Flame Buffet. 20 hits unlocks a Mythic Quest. Reward: After hitting 20 Heroes, hitting a Burning enemy Hero with Flame Buffet reduces Dragonqueen's cooldown by 6 seconds. Mythic Quest: After

AlexstraszaSurgeOfVitalityAbundance.name: Surge of Vitality
AlexstraszaSurgeOfVitalityAbundance.description: Abundance's healing burst grants allied Heroes 30% Movement Speed for 3 seconds.

AlexstraszaHeatExhaustionFlameBuffet.name: Heat Exhaustion
AlexstraszaHeatExhaustionFlameBuffet.description: Increase Flame Buffet's Slow from 40% to 50% and cause it to no longer decay.

AlexstraszaExuberance.name: Exuberance
AlexstraszaExuberance.description: While above 75% Health, gain 15% Movement Speed.

AlexstraszaLifeblossomGiftOfLife.name: Lifeblossom
AlexstraszaLifeblossomGiftOfLife.description: While above 75% Health, casting Gift of Life creates a Lifeblossom at the target's location, Breath of Life instead removes Slows and Roots from the target. After collecting a Lifeblossom, the next Gift of Life costs no Health. Passive: Reduces the cost of Gift of Life to 10% of

AlexstraszaVerdantFlourishAbundance.name: Verdant Flourish
AlexstraszaVerdantFlourishAbundance.description: Alexstrasza receives 40% more healing from Abundance and 100% more healing from Regeneration Globes.

AlexstraszaFireWithinFlameBuffet.name: Fire Within
AlexstraszaFireWithinFlameBuffet.description: Hitting a Burning Hero with Flame Buffet heals Alexstrasza for 10% of her maximum Health.

AlexstraszaLifebinder.name: Life-Binder
AlexstraszaLifebinder.description: Bind Alexstrasza's life force with an allied Hero. Both her and her target are healed for 480 Health over 2 seconds. Afterwards, the Hero with a lower percentage of Health is healed to the same Health percentage as the other Hero. Dragonqueen: Cast range increased by 45%.

AlexstraszaCleansingFlame.name: Cleansing Flame
AlexstraszaCleansingFlame.description: After 1.25 seconds, take to the sky and drop 5 fireballs over 6 seconds at the position of the mouse cursor. Fireballs deal 135 damage to enemies and heal allied Heroes for 300 Health. 2 seconds after dropping all fireballs, Alexstrasza lands at the position of the mouse cursor.

AlexstraszaDragonScales.name: Dragon Scales
AlexstraszaDragonScales.description: Gain 50 Armor while Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced, and for 2 seconds after. Can only trigger once every 10 seconds.

AlexstraszaPacify.name: Pacify
AlexstraszaPacify.description: Activate to Slow and reduce an enemy Hero's damage by 50% for 3 seconds. Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Pacify's cooldown by 30 seconds.

AlexstraszaLifeUnbound.name: Life Unbound
AlexstraszaLifeUnbound.description: Activate to heal an allied Hero for 15% of their maximum Health and deal 200 damage to nearby enemies. Healing a Stunned, Rooted, or Silenced ally reduces Life Unbound's cooldown by 30 seconds. Cannot be used on Alexstrasza.

AlexstraszaToughLoveGiftOfLife.name: Tough Love
AlexstraszaToughLoveGiftOfLife.description: Gift of Life grants its target 10 Armor for 2.5 seconds, increased to 30 while Alexstrasza is above 75% Health.

AlexstraszaOverprotectiveAbundance.name: Overprotective
AlexstraszaOverprotectiveAbundance.description: Heroes healed by Abundance gain a Shield for 6 seconds equal to 50% of the amount healed.

AlexstraszaDraconicDisciplineDragonqueen.name: Draconic Discipline
AlexstraszaDraconicDisciplineDragonqueen.description: Increase Dragonqueen Basic Attack healing by 50%. For each allied Hero healed with Dragonqueen Basic Attacks, reduce Preservation's cooldown by 1.25 seconds.

AlexstraszaOnRubyWingsCleansingFlame.name: On Ruby Wings
AlexstraszaOnRubyWingsCleansingFlame.description: Healing or damaging 3 or more Heroes with a single Cleansing Flame fireball causes that fireball to not be consumed.

AlexstraszaAncientFlameFlameBuffet.name: Ancient Flame
AlexstraszaAncientFlameFlameBuffet.description: While Dragonqueen is active, Alexstrasza's Basic Attacks apply Flame Buffet. This does not grant Quest stacks. Passive: Dragonqueen grants 25% more maxium Health.

AlexstraszaBlessingOfTheRed.name: Blessing of the Red
AlexstraszaBlessingOfTheRed.description: Activate to grant an allied Hero 500 bonus maximum Health until they die. Cannot be used on Alexstrasza, or on a Hero who already has Blessing of the Red.
